front: Shout a one-word order that forces a creature to obey: approach, flee, drop, release, or stand still.
back:
Command target to approach, run away (as fleeing), release what it holds, drop prone, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take reactions until it obeys. Will save:
Success: unaffected.
Failure: spends its first action next turn obeying.
Crit Failure: spends all actions next turn obeying.
Heightened (5th): up to 10 targets.
